text.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: coordinating and resumptive connector that keeps the new self-classification inside the continuing jinn testimony

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following content particle with first-person plural suffix

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) begins the ayah by carrying the jinn testimony forward, so the moral taxonomy that follows is self-report rather than detached commentary. Its prefixed form leans directly into {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}), making continuation inseparable from the clause it introduces. The bridge also carries the prior uncertainty of 72:10 into a new act of communal self-classification.

topics.headline: self-classification inside the testimony chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's moral classification remains part of the jinn's cumulative testimony, not an outside narrator's taxonomy.
topics.reason: The opening connector scopes the following content particle and continues the quoted testimony sequence from the previous ayah.

topics.headline: prefixed connector fused to the report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the connector is formally light but functionally decisive, choosing linkage before any subgroup is named.
topics.reason: The particle is written and recited as a proclitic on the following clause, with both coordination and resumption locally coherent.

words.gloss_range: subordinating/assertive content particle fused with a first-person plural suffix; accepted reading variation shifts report toward emphatic self-witness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted variant with stronger assertive force

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}) holds the whole classification inside the reported jinn testimony while also giving it a first-person plural owner. The accepted {{ar:وَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:wa-innā}}) reading can make the line sound like renewed emphatic self-witness, but the collective speaker remains the same. Because the particle and suffix are fused, embedding and communal confession arrive in one compact form.

topics.headline: embedded report with assertive variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reading variation affects whether the self-disclosure sounds embedded or freshly emphatic, without changing who speaks.
topics.reason: The aligned surface functions in the reported clause, while the accepted variant supplies a real but bounded assertion contrast.

topics.headline: plural suffix makes the taxonomy a confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the moral plurality is owned by the speaking collective itself rather than assigned from outside.
topics.reason: The first-person plural suffix continues the jinn speaker group and makes the classification self-involving.

topics.headline: one particle governs the whole taxonomy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two partitive clauses and the final state diagnosis are held together as one reported unit.
topics.reason: The content particle introduces the larger clause span rather than only the first subgroup phrase.

words.gloss_range: fronted partitive phrase, from or among us, marking the righteous as an internal subgroup
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}) first maps the field as from within the speaking group, and only then does {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣāliḥūna}}) name the righteous class. The fused preposition and suffix compress source, membership, and self-reference into one marker. Its fronted position also creates the template that the later {{ar:وَمِنَّا}} ({{tr:wa-minnā}}) repeats, so the ayah builds a distribution map before naming the community's divided paths.

topics.headline: righteousness selected from inside the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that righteousness is an internal subgroup within the jinn speakers, not a category placed outside them.
topics.reason: The fronted partitive phrase is attached to the righteous class and carries the first-person plural suffix.

topics.headline: fronted phrase sets the repeated frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah first establish the communal field, then reuse that frame for the contrasting subgroup.
topics.reason: The repeated partitive construction licenses the parallel classification that follows.

words.gloss_range: the definite righteous or sound ones as a stable class and benchmark within the speakers
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, rightness, fitness, and repair against corruption; local active participle selects the righteous-person class, while repair and reconciliation remain supporting pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣāliḥūna}}) names a definite, formed class among the speakers, not scattered moments of good conduct. Its long participial surface gives the first named class recitational weight before the terse below-that counter-phrase. Because {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) later points back to this class or status, the word becomes the ayah's moral benchmark. The {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) field keeps soundness, fitness, repair, and reconciliation in view, so the class stands as the sound pole before the ayah ends with paths cut apart. Echoes such as false reform language in 2:11 and the later same-surah dividing frame in 72:14 sharpen this benchmark without replacing the local active participle.

topics.headline: recognizable righteous class as benchmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first subgroup becomes the standard by which the unnamed second group is measured.
topics.reason: The definite active participle names a stable class, and the later demonstrative is resolved back to it.

topics.headline: soundness and repair behind righteousness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees righteousness as sound, fit, and restorative, while local grammar keeps the active-participle righteous class as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The broader root family supports soundness and repair pressure, but non-surface derivative senses do not replace the local participial noun.

topics.headline: definite sound plural gives the class weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the class is embodied and stable before any relational shortfall is named.
topics.reason: The definite sound plural active participle presents a formed group inside the preceding partitive frame.

topics.headline: wider righteousness field sharpened locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this local benchmark participates in larger repair and division patterns, including a contrast with false reform in 2:11 and a same-surah sharpening in 72:14.
topics.reason: The supplied intertext and distribution rows support benchmark pressure without overriding the local reference.

topics.headline: later demonstrative reuses the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first label continue to govern the second clause through a demonstrative rather than through repetition.
topics.reason: The following demonstrative makes the righteous class or status the discourse object of comparison.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector prefixed to the second partitive phrase, preserving parallelism while introducing contrast
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not break the taxonomy; it resumes the same frame and lets contrast arise through parallelism. By attaching to the second {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}), it keeps the lower group inside the same speaking collective. The repeated frame becomes audible before the final image explains the internal division.

topics.headline: parallel conjunction with contrastive force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second group is contrasted without leaving the shared among-us frame.
topics.reason: The connector coordinates the second partitive phrase while the changed predicate supplies the contrast.

topics.headline: repeated frame made audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the classification as a repeated self-inclusion pattern before the ayah names fragmentation.
topics.reason: The second connector preserves the syntactic template and helps create the local refrain.

words.gloss_range: repeated partitive phrase, from or among us, introducing the unnamed subgroup below the benchmark
words.prose: The second {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}) repeats the same among-us marker for the group below the righteous benchmark. That repetition blocks any scapegoating outside the speaker group: both soundness and shortfall belong within the same collective. Yet the expected class noun is withheld, so {{ar:دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dūna dhālika}}) carries the evaluation as relational distance rather than a fixed vice-label.

topics.headline: deficiency kept inside the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lesser group is still from among the same confessing speakers.
topics.reason: The repeated partitive phrase is coordinated with the first and carries the same first-person plural suffix.

topics.headline: ellipsis makes shortfall relational
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah avoids naming a second opposed class and instead measures it by distance from righteousness.
topics.reason: The fronted second partitive repeats the template, but the noun label is omitted and the following relation supplies the evaluation.

words.gloss_range: below, short of, apart from, or other than; locally a relational rank marker governing the following demonstrative
words.root_gloss_range: lower-than, short-of, other-than, and apart-from relations; local grammar selects measured non-attainment beneath the righteous benchmark, not religion/debt or register branches
words.prose: {{ar:دُونَ}} ({{tr:dūna}}) makes the second group a matter of measured rank: below, short of, or apart from the righteous benchmark. Since it governs {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}), the shortfall is not vague; it is calibrated against the class just named. The broader {{ar:د و ن}} ({{tr:d-w-n}}) range supports lower-than and other-than pressure here, while the local phrase blocks unrelated religion/debt or register branches. Its compact d/n/dh/l articulation moves from among-us to below-that before the harder closing severance arrives.

topics.headline: below-that relation fixes the moral measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unnamed group is measured by distance from the righteous class, not defined by an independent label.
topics.reason: The adverbial noun governs the demonstrative complement and is attached to the second partitive phrase.

topics.headline: below and other-than both survive locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees moral difference as a spatial and ranked distance from a visible standard, while the local phrase keeps the range tethered to that benchmark.
topics.reason: The accepted lower-than and other-than branches fit the phrase, but the demonstrative complement prevents a free-floating general inferiority reading.

topics.headline: not religion or register semantics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the word in the rank-and-distance field instead of importing unrelated root or register meanings.
topics.reason: Reference evidence distinguishes the local {{ar:د و ن}} ({{tr:d-w-n}}) form from unrelated theology, debt, and recording branches.

topics.headline: rank language participates in the surah's separation field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this lower-relation wording is not isolated, since the same surah later keeps the apart-from field active at 72:22.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and same-surah evidence support a local rank and separation thread.

topics.headline: sound carries the step into below-that
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the phrase move compactly from shared membership into measured distance before the final cut-word.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the rank word between the partitive pronoun and the demonstrative benchmark.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative pointing back to the righteous class or its status as the benchmark
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) compresses the prior righteous class into a demonstrative benchmark. Its masculine singular form points to the status or condition of righteousness, not merely to plural individuals. Placed after {{ar:دُونَ}} ({{tr:dūna}}), it resolves what the second group falls short of and then closes the nominal classification before {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) turns the whole pattern into a state diagnosis.

topics.headline: demonstrative carries the prior class forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second clause does not invent a new standard; it points back to the righteousness just named.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is resolved to the prior righteous class or status and serves as the complement of the rank word.

topics.headline: singular form points to status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the comparison targets righteousness as a condition, not simply the individual members of the first group.
topics.reason: The masculine singular demonstrative refers to the benchmark status even though the prior named group is plural.

topics.headline: benchmark phrase closes before the verbal diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah resolve the comparison first, then pivot from classification into collective diagnosis.
topics.reason: The demonstrative completes the second nominal beat immediately before the copular clause begins.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural perfect defective/copular verb, we were, governing the divided-path predicate
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, temporal predication, configuration, and place/rank extensions; local Form I perfect selects copular state, not causative forming or divine creative command
words.prose: {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) pivots from two nominal classifications into one copular diagnosis: the speakers were {{ar:طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭarāʾiqa qidadan}}), ways cut apart. The perfect form frames that division as an acknowledged established condition, and the first-person plural suffix keeps the same confessing group active. The broader {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) field can speak of being, configuration, and locus, but the local Form I verb states a creaturely condition rather than making the speakers agents who caused it or echoing divine bringing-to-be in 2:117 as the governing sense.

topics.headline: being verb turns taxonomy into state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that division is predicated as what the speakers were, not as an action merely reported about them.
topics.reason: The defective verb takes the following accusative predicate and has no object frame.

topics.headline: established past state owned by the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divided condition as a recognized prior state confessed by the same we-voice.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural form combines past-state framing with the continuing speaker suffix.

topics.headline: configuration pressure without causative overread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate describes a configuration of communal existence, while local form keeps simple being rather than causative self-formation.
topics.reason: The root family supports being, constitution, and locus imagery, but the local verb is simple Form I copular usage.

topics.headline: state vocabulary contrasted with divine bringing-to-be
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this word as part of surah-local state language, while the contrast with 2:117 keeps creaturely condition distinct from divine bringing-to-be.
topics.reason: The supplied intertext and recurrence evidence are useful as contrast and local thread, not as a replacement for the copular parse.

topics.headline: two partitives synthesized into one clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah move from internal ranking to a whole-community diagnosis of fractured being.
topics.reason: The copular clause follows two nominal partitive clauses and gathers their moral taxonomy into the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: plural ways, paths, courses, methods, or affiliations; locally the accusative predicate of the speakers' being, qualified by the final cut-apart word
words.root_gloss_range: route, way, course, manner, and related path imagery; local noun selects the extended-way branch, while striking, night-arrival, divination, and other branches stay background only
words.prose: {{ar:طَرَآئِقَ}} ({{tr:ṭarāʾiqa}}) is the plural predicate of {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}), so the speakers' identity is cast as ways or courses before the final qualifier cuts those ways apart. Its range keeps practical routes, manners, doctrines, and affiliations jointly available rather than reducing the phrase to a single abstract label. The broken plural and written madd give breadth to the many routes, then the hamza break and later q/d stops let {{ar:قِدَدًۭا}} ({{tr:qidadan}}) determine that breadth as severed. Same-surah contrast with the singular path-form at 72:16 and the ordered heavenly layers of 23:17 sharpen the local image of creaturely fragmentation. Because this route vocabulary is a relatively uncommon, concentrated path field, the penultimate word carries marked weight in the ayah's closing image.

topics.headline: plural ways define what the speakers were
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that multiplicity is not an aside; plural ways are the predicate that defines the speakers' state.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the predicate of the copular verb and is plural before the final qualifier.

topics.headline: way and course range remains active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the division as practical, doctrinal, and social courses at once, while the local noun keeps the extended-way branch selected.
topics.reason: The extended-way branch fits the local predicate and qualifier, while unrelated root branches do not control the parse.

topics.headline: ways first, severance second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the phrase move from plurality to the harsher diagnosis of cut-apart plurality.
topics.reason: The predicate noun precedes its qualifier, so route plurality is named before severance determines its character.

topics.headline: plural paths answer singular path and ordered layers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that many divided paths here contrast with the singular path-form at 72:16 and with ordered layers in 23:17.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah evidence gives concrete references that sharpen, but do not govern, the local predicate.

topics.headline: plural route word sounds broad before the cut
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees breadth in the route word before the closing consonants segment it into cut paths.
topics.reason: The written madd, broken plural, route-noun form, and sound texture all work locally with the following qualifier.

topics.headline: uncommon route root carries the closing image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this relatively uncommon route vocabulary has special weight in the ayah's closing image.
topics.reason: The occurrence profile marks the route noun as a small, image-bearing field in the local close.

words.gloss_range: cut apart, divided, separated strips or factions; locally an indefinite accusative qualifier of the plural ways
words.root_gloss_range: lengthwise cutting, splitting, cut strips, diverging paths and parties, and resulting separated portions; local noun selects the result/fragmentation image, not sufficiency, particle, drink, or unrelated branches
words.prose: {{ar:قِدَدًۭا}} ({{tr:qidadan}}) lands as the final qualifier of {{ar:طَرَآئِقَ}} ({{tr:ṭarāʾiqa}}), so severance modifies the paths themselves rather than floating as a separate claim. Its indefinite plural/result form leaves the fragmentation uncounted, but the rare nominal choice concentrates the diagnosis in one closing image. The final tanwin and hard q/d cadence make that open-ended severance audible. The {{ar:ق د د}} ({{tr:q-d-d}}) field gives the abstract division material force: cut lengthwise, split into strips, and already in a separated condition. The torn-cloth scene of 12:25 becomes a contrastive echo, because here the truth exposed at the close is a torn community; the same-surah singular path at 72:16 then stands against these many cut paths. The close also looks back from 72:10's outward uncertainty to 72:11's inward moral calibration, so the final cut-image reads as confessed self-examination.

topics.headline: severance qualifies the ways themselves
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not end at many ways, but at ways specifically qualified as cut apart.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite accusative qualifier of the plural predicate and closes the ayah.

topics.headline: cut-strip image makes diversity feel severed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels doctrinal or social plurality as material severance rather than neutral variety.
topics.reason: The accepted cutting and split-strip branches fit the local metaphor, while non-surface derivatives only sharpen the result image.

topics.headline: rare nominal result, not narrated cutting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees an already fragmented condition, not a narrated act of cutting.
topics.reason: The local nominal form and plural/collective shape present the result of severance; derivative cutting verbs remain background intensifiers.

topics.headline: rare nominal concentrates the diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final diagnosis rests on a rare nominal image, making the close especially concentrated.
topics.reason: The occurrence evidence marks this noun as a unique or low-occurrence nominal carrier of the final image.

topics.headline: torn cloth and singular path sharpen the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 12:25 exposes truth through torn cloth, while 72:11 exposes a torn community and 72:16 contrasts these cut paths with a singular path-form.
topics.reason: The supplied concrete references provide contrastive echoes that sharpen the local severance image.

topics.headline: final word rereads the whole taxonomy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earlier among-us distribution reread as evidence of deeper internal severing.
topics.reason: The closing qualifier synthesizes the two partitive classifications into a final self-diagnosis of fragmentation.

topics.headline: tanwin and hard stops close the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an indefinite, hard-edged close that leaves the number of divisions open while making the image memorable.
topics.reason: The final tanwin, plural/result form, and q/d consonants reinforce the indefinite closing diagnosis.

topics.headline: boundary shift ends in first-person fragmentation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from 72:10's outward uncertainty into 72:11's inward moral calibration and confessed fragmentation.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the previous ayah's concern with guidance to this ayah's internal moral scale.

strongest_changes: Kunna plus the hearing-to-belief sequence makes the focus plurality readable as a prior configuration undergoing reorientation.
The repeated 'among us' syntax in 72:14 turns open diversity into ethically unequal response trajectories while leaving the category mapping non-identical.
The straight-path/water and final watch/enumeration sequences make divergent ways function as aligned or misaligned conduits that remain bounded and legible.
summary.what_was_special: The focus itself fuses moral rank, social parties, extended tracks, and lengthwise cutting. Context then reuses that topology through syntactic reclassification, hydraulic flow, blocked lateral refuge, watched roads, and exhaustive counting, allowing several causal models to coexist without collapsing the paths into one metaphor.
remaining_uncertainties: Kunna may mark a completed pre-guidance state or merely background a plurality that continues.
The hydraulic and textile mechanisms may be explanatory analogies rather than semantic force in the focus wording.
The salihun/other partition and the muslimun/qasitun partition may overlap without mapping one-to-one.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Moral plurality materialized as cut-apart routes.** `الصالحون` activates ص ل ح B001/B003, soundness and fitness; `دون` activates د و ن B001-B003, what is lower, short of, or other than; `طرائق` activates ط ر ق B002/B010, extended ways and habitual courses; and `قددا` activates ق د د B001/B004, lengthwise cutting and diverging parties. The first clause distinguishes internal moral positions; the second recasts them as pathways separated by cuts. The inferred mechanism is that repeated dispositions produce route-like social formations. The ayah reads diversity not as a static list of types but as communities being carried along divergent courses.

2. **“Below that” remains graded rather than binary.** The branches of د و ن preserve nearness short of a limit (B001), lowness (B002), and otherness (B003), while `قددا` pluralizes division. The structural cue is `منا ... ومنا`, an internal distribution rather than an outside enemy contrast. The abductive move is that departures from fitness can differ in degree and direction. The ayah therefore resists collapsing every non-`صالح` group into one identical category.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:14 repeats the internal partition as submitters and deviators, while 72:16 turns the path image into a condition of upright alignment. The later ayat convert descriptive plurality into consequential route-choice.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ` preserves graded shortfall rather than a simple opposite.** Fixed `ص ل ح` B001 is soundness against corruption and B003 fitness for something; fixed `د و ن` B001 is nearness that falls short of a limit, while B003 is other-than or lower in rank. The repeated `مِنَّا` partitions one population, but the second class is described relationally as below/short of `ذَٰلِكَ`, not directly named "corrupt." The packet supplies a standard and scalar distance from it; I infer that members can be differently fitted to sound action. The verse reads as a graded internal audit before the sharper outcome-based division of 72:14-15.

2. **Plural ways are cut from one social body.** Fixed `ط ر ق` B002 is an extended course, social way, group, or layer; fixed `ق د د` B004 is divergent paths and parties, while B001 supplies lengthwise cutting. After the paired human/jinn assumptions of 72:5-7 and before the paired `مِنَّا` groups of 72:14, the two plurals depict one collective separated along enduring trajectories. The packet supplies path, party, and longitudinal division; I infer that repeated choices cut channels through a shared population. `طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا` reads as socially embodied routes, not a loose statement of diversity.

3. **The later singular path does not erase the sound persons already inside plurality.** The forward window reaches `ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ` in 72:16, a singular course paired with `ٱسْتَقَامُوا`; yet this fixed ayah first says some among the many `طَرَائِق` are `ٱلصَّالِحُونَ`. The packet supplies plural paths containing sound agents and a later singular straightened course; I infer that the change is alignment toward a common operative trajectory, not proof that every prior distinction was equally corrupt. The verse reads as preserving real internal difference while preparing a convergence test.

4. **Reconciliation is a latent capacity within division.** Fixed `ص ل ح` B002 is removal of estrangement through settlement. The nearby sequence moves from harmful cross-group reliance (72:6), through self-differentiation here, to hearing and surrender (72:13-14). The packet supplies divided parties and a reconciliation branch anchored in `ٱلصَّالِحُونَ`; I infer that sound members can function as points through which a fragmented collective becomes re-orderable. This is exploratory because no explicit mutual settlement occurs in the fixed clause, but it changes `الصالحون` from a private moral label to a possible social repair role.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:24 compares apparent helpers by `عَدَد`, and 72:28 encloses `كُلَّ شَىْءٍ` in exhaustive enumeration. That final accounting does not collapse the fixed plurality; it explains how graded members and cut paths remain separately legible inside one total field. The surprise is that differentiation and totality are complementary: `ق د د` B004 supplies real divergence, while the closing count prevents any route from becoming untracked.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Refuge Brokerage Reverses into Encroachment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protection relation should place a vulnerable party within another's shelter, but the human-jinn arrangement reverses the roles and enlarges the very pressure it was meant to contain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Refuge appears as a social contract, a physical enclosure, and an occult appliance; every form is vulnerable to capture by the broker who claims to provide it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Protective devices become means of restraint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A charm, amulet, shield, hidden place, or divinatory procedure is installed to ward off danger, yet the same apparatus can immobilize judgment or hold its user.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an incantation or bead that restrains marriage or opinion (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); amulet and protective recitation (`quranic:root_001059:B002/m01`); a shield used for defense (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); a hiding place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); a covenant of protection (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); divination by pebbles or traced marks (`quranic:root_000932:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The protective field is materially complete: spoken formula, portable amulet, shield, hiding place, covenant, and divinatory reading. The crucial reversal is already present inside the evidence: the charm that should secure its bearer can instead bind a person or arrest a decision. That reversal prepares the surface outcome in which recourse to hidden protectors increases rather than relieves exposure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sky Listening Becomes a Reversed Hunt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The listening blind is itself trapped
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A watcher sits in concealment to intercept sound, but the route and station have already been prepared as an ambush and snare.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed sitting place (`quranic:root_001244:B001/m01`); sitting in surveillance (`quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`); auditory capture (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); the ear as receiving aperture (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); watch and ambush (`quranic:root_000566:B001/m01`); prepared allocation (`quranic:root_000566:B002/m01`); a designated watch-place or trap (`quranic:root_000566:B003/m01`); hunter's snare (`quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`); set trap (`quranic:root_000932:B013/m01`); stalking behind cover (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); defensive screen (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sitting, watching, and listening define a concealed observation post. The trap branches reverse its direction: the same route on which the listener waits is a prepared capture point, and the hunter's blind becomes the defender's snare. This role reversal explains the abrupt replacement of access by interception without reducing the scene to generic "security."

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: A Community Is Sorted into Cuts, Tracks, and Measured Alignment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective difference is materialized as longitudinal cuts and traversable tracks, then evaluated by whether a course is straight, balanced, or structurally warped.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social and moral differentiation becomes a fabrication process: material is cut into strips, laid as routes, checked against a straight measure, and rejected as crooked dry stock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: One collective is cut into distinct routes
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A previously gathered body is split lengthwise into strips and factions, each of which takes a repeated track or manner.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an extended route or manner (`quranic:root_000932:B002/m01`); layer placed over layer (`quranic:root_000932:B007/m01`); one trace following another (`quranic:root_000932:B009/m01`); habitual procedure (`quranic:root_000932:B010/m01`); longitudinal cutting (`quranic:root_001204:B001/m01`); divergent factions and methods (`quranic:root_001204:B004/m01`); discriminating division and management (`quranic:root_001204:B005/m01`); cutting across open country (`quranic:root_001204:B006/m01`); visible colored bands and tracks (`quranic:root_000227:B005/m01`); a level road surface (`quranic:root_000227:B007/m01`); repair opposed to corruption (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`); reconciliation after estrangement (`quranic:root_000876:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The community is not merely plural. Longitudinal cutting produces distinct strips; visible bands make the division perceptible; repeated tracks convert each strip into a sustained practice. Repair and reconciliation remain possible operations on this divided material, so difference need not be identical with permanent rupture.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağımsız bir genel nitelik değil, belirli bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun ve onun alanından olması biçimindeki yapıya bağlı anlam verir. identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanmış çerçeve kayıtları yazıya geçirme eylemini öne çıkarır, ancak kaynak ifadesi önce kayıt adının biçim açıklamasını ve çoğulunu, ardından kayıtların düzenlenmesi eylemini verir. Dal bu iki parçayı ayırarak korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kayıt adını taşıyan biçim ile kayıtları düzenlemeyi anlatan kalıp ayrı gösterilir; eylem anlamı adın bütün kullanımlarına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Düzenli kayıtların toplandığı defter veya kayıt bütünü ile bu kayıtları yazıya geçirip düzenleme eylemini kapsar. Adın biçimi, eski bir biçimdeki iki benzer ünsüzden birinin başka bir sesle karşılanmasıyla açıklanır ve çoğulu bu açıklamaya kanıt gösterilir.

facets.statement: Düzenli kayıtları bir arada tutan defter veya örgütlü kayıt bütünü adlandırılır.

Adın biçimi eski bir ses düzenine bağlanır ve çoğul biçim bu açıklamanın dayanağı sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek aktarım, kayıt adının biçimini eski bir ses düzeni ve çoğul biçim üzerinden açıklar; ayrıca bu kayıtların yazıya geçirilip düzenlendiğini bildiren kullanımı verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi enine değil boyuna doğru kesme veya yarma eylemini açıkça merkeze alır. Yarılma sonucu ve bu işte kullanılan demir araç, aynı çekirdeğe bağlı ikincil kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel kesmeyi değil, kesme ya da yarma yönünün boyuna olduğu durumu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım boyuna kesme çekirdeğini korur; eylem, sonuç ve araç biçimleri birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi uzunluğu boyunca kesmek ya da boydan boya yarmaktır. Aynı çekirdeğe, böyle bir kesikle yarılma ve kesmede kullanılan demir araç da bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Kesme veya yarma, nesnenin uzunluğu boyunca yapılır; enine kesme bu sınırın dışındadır.
Eylemin sonucu, nesnenin boyuna doğru yarılması veya açılmasıdır.
Bu tür kesme işinde kullanılan demir araç da aynı anlam çevresinde adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yönü uzunlamasına olan kesme ve yarma anlamında birleşir; enine kesmeyi açıkça karşıt tutar ve yarılma sonucu ile kesme aracını da kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yön belirten temel eylemini, enine kesmeyle karışmayacak biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Uzunluk yönünü ve kesme ya da yarma işlemini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kesilmiş şey, tabaklanmamış deri şeritleri, oğlak derisi, deri kap, kurutulmuş et ve eski giysi gibi farklı adlandırmaları birlikte verir. Bunlar kesme sonucu çevresinde ilişkilidir, ancak tek bir nesne türüymüş gibi tanımlanmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kesilmiş ürün çekirdeği ile kalıplaşmış deri, et ve giysi adlarını ayrı alt kullanımlar olarak tutar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kesilmiş ürün çekirdeğini biçimlere bağlar; atasözü niteliğindeki kullanım yalnız kendi kalıbıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kesilerek parça veya şerit haline getirilmiş şeyleri ve bu işlemle bağlantılı kalıplaşmış nesne adlarını kapsar. Bunlar tabaklanmamış deri şeritleri ve deri kaplardan kurutulmuş ete, ayrıca eski giysi ve küçük işi büyütme söz kalıbına kadar ayrışır.

facets.statement: Temel bağıntı, bir nesnenin kesilmiş veya şerit halinde hazırlanmış ürün olmasıdır.
Tabaklanmamış deriden kesilen şerit, oğlak derisi, küçük deri kap ve deri kap bu çekirdeğin deri alanındaki adlarıdır.
Kurutulmuş et ile eskimiş giysi de kalıplaşmış nesne adları olarak bu dalda yer alır.
Belirli bir söz kalıbı, kişinin küçük bir işini gereğinden büyük hale getirmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kesilmiş şey ve deri şerit anlamlarını ortaklaştırır; ayrıca oğlak derisi, deri kap, kurutulmuş et, eski giysi ve küçük işi büyütme sözünü aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın boyunu, beden yapısındaki düzgün oranı ve güzel biçimlenişi ortak bir çekirdekte toplar. Uzun sırtlı dişi deve kullanımı ise insan bedenine ait çekirdeğin doğrudan parçası değil, uzunluk niteliğine dayalı özel bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Boy ve beden oranı temel anlamdır; uzun sırtlı deve yalnız özel bir hayvan betimlemesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel boy ve oran çekirdeğini özel söz kalıplarından ve hayvan betimlemesinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: İnsan bedeninin boyca uzanışı ile parçalarının düzgün ve ölçülü görünüşüdür. Uzun sırtlı dişi deve adı, uzunluk niteliğine dayanan özel bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninin boyu ve bu boy boyunca parçaların ölçülü biçimlenişi birlikte anlatılır.
Bir insanın düzgün yapılı ve oranlı görünmesi, çekirdeğin olumlu niteleme kullanımıdır.
Yere doğru uzanan uzun sırtlı dişi deve için kullanılan ad, boyca uzama niteliğini özelleştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insan boyu ile bedenin düzgün ve ölçülü biçimlenişini birlikte verir; bir kaynak açıklaması ayrıca uzun sırtlı dişi deve adını bu uzunluk çevresine bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem birbirinden ayrı yolları hem de eğilimleri farklı olduğu için ayrışmış insan gruplarını açıkça kapsar. Dağılma eylemi bu iki görünümü birleştiren ayrışma çekirdeğini doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her topluluk değil, farklı yol veya eğilimler yüzünden birbirinden ayrılan yollar ve gruplar anlatılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yol ve insan grubu anlamlarını ayrışma çekirdeğinde tutar; kalıplaşmış çoğul kullanım genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Yolların, tutumların veya insan topluluklarının birbirinden ayrılıp farklı yönler oluşturmasıdır. İnsan grubu kullanımında üyelerin ya da grupların eğilim ayrılığı belirleyicidir.

facets.statement: Ortak çekirdek, yolların veya toplulukların birbirinden ayrılarak farklı yönler oluşturmasıdır.
İnsan grubu kullanımında ayrılık, kişilerin veya grupların farklı eğilimler taşımasına dayanır.
Bir topluluğun dağılması ve ayrı parçalara bölünmesi, çekirdeğin eylem görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar farklı yollar, eğilimleri ayrışmış insan toplulukları ve topluluğun dağılması anlamlarını aynı ayrılma çekirdeğinde birleştirir.
